mechanism_narrative: A lower current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate environments (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% over the past month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the past month signals a broad-based demand contraction, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In supply shock regimes (INDPRO declining and below 100), a further decline in industrial production predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In supply shock regimes (INDPRO < 100 and declining), SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher current retail sales figure (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 2.5% over the past month predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in monthly payroll growth (PAYEMS) signals a deteriorating labor market, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high monetary policy rate environments (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%), a rise in the federal funds rate predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In high-rate environments (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%), SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.
